comment: Inference-engine builds, versioned + sha256-pinned like model packages (§27). PENDING hashes fail closed until pinned: the Pin & Verify workflow (or pin-runtime.js on a networked machine) fills them and CI commits them back after the real E2E passes. binPath is the server binary inside the extracted archive; extras are companion archives extracted into the same directory (CUDA needs the cudart runtime). llama.cpp publishes no Linux release binaries — Linux dev machines build from source and point KAI_LLAMA_BIN at it; the §9 server edition will carry its own packaging.
